summary: Improved leaf-cluster breakup and bark contrast, species-aware impostor tint, LOD1 shadows, terrain-conforming lamp pools, fence orientation, signal phase grouping/rendering, and save/restore fidelity. Removed a real dropped-draw GL sampler failure and the separate missing vertex-color signal defect. Full evidence captured; several visual and editing criteria remain unfinished.
remainingWeaknesses: Foliage remains visibly made from flat leaf-cluster cards; branch structure is clearer but near crowns and far silhouettes do not match the CS2 reference quality.

Aerial impostors render as horizontal circular caps, with a visible change in shape and palette between detailed trees and impostors. Top-down shadows and the 620 m furniture radius remain documented deviations.
Foliage speckle exceeds the 0.05% threshold: fixed-noon props masks at 480 px measure forest 1.581%, skyline 0.989%, aerial 3.069%.

Pinned rectangles are incomplete or contain background: treecloseup has no valid 64 px bark-only trunk rect, conifer rect is absent in key views, and some crown/hedge rects do not isolate their target. Detailed crown segmentation, twelve canopy comparisons, and pure-material thresholds are not established.

Lamp pools now conform to road and sidewalk heights, but the required large pool rect is predominantly cool unlit pavement (lamp mean R-B=-2.634), and lamp-head p99=255 exceeds 250. Some projected pool bounds fill too much of the frame.
Bus shelter glazing remains opaque and the busstop camera looks at its back, hiding the seat and timetable. The park lacks the dense designed furnishing of the reference.

Dirty-region road edits miss the required density independence: 97.3 ms at density 0.25 versus 147.1 ms at 1.0 (1.512x), with 1497 versus 3176 trees. Both edits created three lamps and 8/9 street trees; absolute CPU limits pass.

Full terrain/zone/building rebuilds remain global and can erase manual placements; remove does not fully clean every fence/shelter/pool auxiliary record. Saves produced by this version round-trip exactly, but item-only external saves have incomplete complex-assembly reconstruction.
Camera-motion LOD queue rebuilding still allocates arrays; idle update measurements below timer resolution do not establish an allocation-free update contract.

The all-showcase frame is an empty city with ready modules and zero errors; it does not demonstrate props under a populated integrated city. Heap delta, every-shot props-only budgets, water-region reflection percentages, and independent-load byte determinism were not fully measured.
acceptanceMet: 3a-c and footprint part of 3d: all 3742 items passed ground-height, forbidden-asphalt, water and footprint-overlap probes; no props-owned lights.
2 and 12 data portions: eight species, all twelve frozen kinds present, 3176 trees; no extension of world.props.kinds.

10 behavioral portion: standalone opposing-arm groups corrected; deterministic clock reset/half-cycle and external traffic handover tested, including same-phase greenArms changes without geometry rebuild; signal lenses visibly render after material fixes.
19 save portion: deserialize(serialize()) preserves exact generated items and restores a manually placed bench.

20 measured portions: 16-shot gauntlet max 142 scene draws, 1553254 triangles, 59.2 FPS minimum on Apple M4 Metal, zero errors; seven noon props toggles max 54 draws and 448308 triangles. Initial build 149.9 ms; 30 idle updates each below 0.1 ms timer resolution.
21: all 34 required screenshots and JSONs exist under shots/props/r2, all props ready and errors empty; 21 probe PNGs include the 14 required auxiliary captures and seven matching props-on baselines.
22: no lights, renderer/fog/composer mutation, other module changes or commits by this builder.
23 place portion: bench placement visible in world props and save, 13.5 ms measured / 13.4 ms reported.
24 visual portion: matching 720p/1080p avenue and night forest framing; downscaled difference over 40 L is 0.679% and 0.058%, respectively. Extra forest_22 1080p baseline supplied.
acceptanceMissed: 1, 2 visual, 7, 9: crown/card quality, species verification and crop/mask thresholds remain incomplete or failed.
6: pool warmth and clipped lamp-head highlight do not meet the pinned tests.
11, 12, 13 visual: shelter glazing, furnishing clarity and full placement-spacing proof remain incomplete.
14, 18: visible impostor transition and flat top-down caps; speckle fails.
19, 23: global rebuild/manual-edit preservation, all-kind deletion and density-independent road updates remain incomplete.
20: complete memory attribution and every-shot module deltas not established.
renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M4, Unspecified Version)
viewingMethod: References and early screenshots viewed individually. Final matrix and every required probe viewed in labeled contact sheets; six final gauntlet frames spanning all four cameras, day and night also opened individually.
resolvedWarning: GL_INVALID_OPERATION: glDrawElementsInstanced: Mismatch between texture format and sampler type (signed/unsigned/float/shadow). The lens BasicMaterial skipped environment uniform setup while still including global fog chunks. Setting fog:false removed the unbound uEnvSky sampler; final instrumented GL failures=[] and screenshot errors=[]. The separate vertexColors flag on geometry without a color attribute made all lenses black and was removed; lens discs were brought ahead of the housing face.
unmeasurableRequirements: Per residual.json, the whole-frame 3 m dolly delta includes parallax: measured 21.677% over 40 L, not treated as a numeric LOD failure by itself. Visible tier mismatch remains a real visual finding.

Wind-zero frames at different hours also change environmental lighting: 0.019% over 40 L and 1.365 mean L delta, not interpreted as failed byte determinism. Exact object-only 2-8 px movement is not established.

The published tier histogram cannot measure a transition-band width; source has a 24 m band. Same-depth impostor/LOD1 luminance, hedge amplitude and rail clearance cannot be established by the named image-only probes.
No numeric pass claimed for invalid or missing pinned crop regions.
